name: better-profile-for-vinted-addon
description: Firefox extension that shows item descriptions next to the stats on your own Vinted profile

scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir . --start-url https://www.vinted.de
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir . --overwrite-dest --ignore-files src tsconfig.json package*.json node_modules .idea
